svg.title: 01 / Preserve the session until adoption
svg.desc: Essential workbench concept 01. A dirty session keeps its staged work through the native replacement guard, chooser cancel, candidate progress, candidate failure and pending-work refusal. Reviewed target selected as WF-06; not implemented. Static drawing, synthetic data, not a runtime screenshot.
svg.text: STATIC CONCEPT • synthetic data • not a runtime screenshot
A dirty session keeps its staged work through the guard, cancellation, progress and failure — the shell is never replaced first.
WF-06 runtime-selected 2026-11-13 — no code shipped, gate set still pending

text.tspan: Typed changes remain staged
Review and undo staged edits
Write a reviewed copy

svg.text: Synthetic sample — names, values and timestamps are illustrations, not a fixture and not a measured run.
Effective view: one staged edit on logical row 7 · no filter · no sort
Record reads the effective logical row (ADR 0011): the guard changes no selection, and focus stays inside the dialog while it is open.

text.tspan: This session has staged changes that are not saved. Opening another
dataset replaces the session, its staged edits, its undo history,
and any validation or comparison results.
Session changes are not saved automatically. Export a copy to keep
them.
If you cancel the file chooser, or the file cannot be opened, this
session stays as it is.
Native dialog above the shell; staged work
and panel state stay in the live session.
Initial focus is Stay (focus ring). Escape
cancels the native dialog, so Escape means
Stay.
Export a copy… closes the guard and ends
the intent. It never auto-replaces, resets
edits or marks the session clean.
No filename, path or change count appears
in the guard. Dimmed rows under the card
are abstracted only for legibility.
Clean means no applied outcome in the
active prefix: undo-to-zero,
redo-tail-only and no-op-only histories
are clean.
Nothing was opened. This session is
unchanged.
Chooser cancel or refusal keeps the live
session, history, provider, drafts,
findings, comparison, SQL, pipeline and
Record state.
Opening the new file… The current
session stays open until it is ready.

g.text: Opening progress · illustrative, no measured timing

text.tspan: One candidate only: no Cancel or
abandonment control once candidate
opening begins, and the old session is
inert rather than busy.

g.text: STATE · CANDIDATE FAILURE · C10 / C11 / C14

text.tspan: The file could not be opened. You can
try another file. Nothing in this
session changed.
Raw diagnostics stay inside the closed block,
never in the notice or telemetry. ADR 0047:
failures can retain tables until teardown, with
no per-table release.
Finish or cancel the cell you are editing
first.
This session is still finishing a change.
Replacement stays unavailable until it
finishes.
A column type check is still running.
Replacement stays unavailable until it
finishes.
Role=status, value-free notices: no file, column, cell or
count; refusal leaves no intent and no disabled retry.

svg.text: ACCEPTANCE FLOW · STATES AND ORDER FROM THE v5 TRANSITION TABLE (T0–T11) — DRAWING ONLY

text.tspan: Dirty session: staged changes, not saved
Open gate reads editors, pending commits
and every cast check synchronously
Guard: initial focus Stay · Escape =
Stay
Export a copy… ends the intent, never
auto-replaces; export initiation is not
“saved”
Candidate ready → adopt once · failure →
session unchanged · candidate overlay
isolated
